title: OpenAI plugin interface
description: Validation schema for the com.openai.extension interface payload used by Agent plugin manifests.

displayName.description: Public listing name. Final directory submission limits it to 30 characters.

shortDescription.description: One-line summary shown in listings. Final submission caps it at 30 characters.

longDescription.description: Detailed listing description. Line breaks are allowed.

developerName.description: Name of the developer or company displayed in the listing.

websiteURL.description: HTTPS website URL for the plugin listing.

defaultPrompt.description: Starter prompt(s) shown to users. Up to three prompts are allowed.

logo.description: Relative path to the plugin logo asset. Must point to a square image file.

composerIcon.description: Relative path to the composer icon asset. Must point to a square image file.

brandColor.description: Primary branding color as a six-digit hex string.

brandColorDark.description: Dark-mode branding color as a six-digit hex string.

screenshots.description: Custom UI screenshots; allowed only when the plugin exposes custom UI. Each screenshot must be exactly 706 pixels wide and 400–860 pixels tall. PNG or JPG.
